exposure: twin-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) with third trimester onset
cohort: 143 women with monochorionic diamniotic (MD) twin pregnancies who received prenatal care from the first trimester onward at a single center
finding: Twin-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) with third trimester onset is a relatively rare complication (4% of TTTS cases), but it is important to be aware of the possibility, even in the absence of significant abdominal symptoms.
